decision_needed.question: The governmental funds statement prints 1,520,000.00 as 'Debt service' under Other Financing Sources (positive), while the General Fund schedule prints the same amount as 'Bond proceeds'. Is it bond proceeds?

notes: GAAP (modified accrual governmental funds, accrual proprietary). Only one governmental fund (General). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (pp4-5), expenditures listed by object (function taken from the General Fund departmental schedule p14 where one department holds most of a line; mixed lines general government with review). Intergovernmental 264,270.83 and Charges for services 8,639.61 split using the p13 breakdown (ties exactly). 'Debt service' 1,520,000.00 printed under other financing sources = 'Bond proceeds' on p13; recorded as debt_proceeds. Grants and donations 225,303.60 kept as one line (no grantor or breakdown printed). Ending cash = Cash held by County Treasurer 4,578.38 (p3); CDs 825,572.87 in ending_investments; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position Total column (pp8-9); reported business-type receipts computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursements = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 1,848,431.39 (p2). Operating 'Other' revenue kept other: the Statement of Activities counts it in general revenues 'Other receipts' (69,999.92 + 76,125.00 + 10,500.00 = 156,624.92). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position split by Governmental/Business-type columns. Detail: General Fund revenues (p13) and departmental expenditures (p14); Ambulance and Waste from the nonmajor combining statement (p15); Electric, Water, Sewer and Golf from their proprietary statement columns (pp8-9), as in FY2023/FY2024; the all-funds budgetary schedule (p12) is a combined schedule and is not recorded. All roll-forwards tie. Read pages 1-16 of 16
